title: Polluted evil
description: a cool minecraft mod that adds new ores like tin and asbestos aswell as structures dungeons mobs and more! updated often.
body:
adds new ores like asbestos, bronze, tin and more!
 explore many new biomes that include the slums, calm fields scrub lands and the appha plains with interesting structures like tri-mart and the skyscrapper. polluted evil also adds mobs like the salesman the cryer, eyer, finder, burnlei, bounder and keeper get some weird new achievements like "i thought it was morning" which you get by entering the twilight grove and "smells like a factory" which you get by crafting plastic.

 ITEMS
 polluted evil also adds new bronze bars, buttons, blocks and stairs as well as the new craggle bricks, refined plastic, tin, melted tin,trash,cigarettes, geodes, meat chunks lard bites which is how you get plastic and more!

 for client and server sides
